findings.claim: FY2026、FY2025、FY2024 皆無單一客戶占營收逾 10%；前 10 大客戶占營收 44%、40%、41%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR｜Sandisk 10-K FY2026｜Item 8 Customer Concentration and Credit Risk
findings.excerpt: For 2026, 2025 and 2024, no single customer accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s net revenue. For 2026, 2025, and 2024, the Company’s top 10 customers accounted for 44%, 40% and 41% of the Company’s net revenue, respectively.

findings.claim: 2026-07-03 應收帳款淨額 47 億美元，三家客戶分別占約 19%、12%、10%（前一年僅一家占 11%，淨額 11 億美元）；信用損失準備金不重大，一般不要求擔保品。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR｜Sandisk 10-K FY2026｜Item 8 Customer Concentration and Credit Risk
findings.excerpt: As of July 3, 2026, the Company had net accounts receivable of $4.7 billion and three customers accounted for approximately 19%, 12% and 10%, respectively, of the Company’s outstanding accounts receivable. As of June 27, 2025, the Company had net accounts receivable of $1.1 billion, and one customer accounted for 11% of the Company’s outstanding accounts receivable. Reserves for potential credit losses were not material as of each period end.

note: 未另行搜尋客戶自身信用狀況，僅依一手 10-K 摘錄；客戶信用惡化事件未查證。
